title: Sample Preparation Using DMSO and CSV Input
author: Opentrons
materials: Touch tips to remove droplets from pipette tip.
Touch tip to remove droplets from pipette tip.
Pause to allow visual inspection of the vial.

steps.title: Load CSV file
steps.instruction: Import the CSV or Excel file that contains the columns vial_id, parent_well, dmso_volume, and daughter_column.

steps.title: Transfer DMSO to parent well
steps.instruction: For each row in the CSV, pick up a new 1000 µL tip, aspirate the specified dmso_volume of DMSO from the reservoir at A1 of the 50 mL conical holder in slot 8, touch the tip to remove droplets, dispense the dmso_volume into the parent_well location of the CRO vial holder in slot 9, mix the vial using half the dmso_volume with the same tip, and touch the tip again to remove droplets.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new 1000 µL tip.
Aspirate dmso_volume µL of DMSO from A1 (50 mL) in slot 8.
Dispense dmso_volume µL into the parent_well position of the CRO vial holder in slot 9.
Mix the vial by aspirating and dispensing half of dmso_volume using the same tip.

steps.title: Inspect mixed vials
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol to allow visual inspection of the vials after DMSO addition and mixing, then resume when ready.

steps.title: Transfer compound to daughter tubes
steps.instruction: For each CSV entry, pick up a new 300 µL tip, aspirate 240 µL of compound from the parent_well location of the CRO vial holder in slot 9, touch the tip to remove droplets, dispense 30 µL into each tube of the specified daughter_column (touch tip after each dispense), and discard the tip.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new 300 µL tip.
Aspirate 240 µL of compound from the parent_well position of the CRO vial holder in slot 9.
For each tube in the daughter_column indicated in the CSV, dispense 30 µL and touch the tip after dispensing.
